mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE > 8.5, or average return in triggered months is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) signal broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 signals an industrial slowdown that reduces corporate output capacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 95.0, or average return in regime is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers Fed rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS increase, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 2.0% (GDPC1 < 13300.0) indicates low economic growth that increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with GDPC1 < 13300.0, or average return in regime is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) and rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.05) signals monetary tightening during industrial slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC for interaction falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
